issue.title: Bug: syslog/test_logrotate_small_size setup/cleanup failure after /var/log remount

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic (t2 topology via Elastictest)

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`tests/syslog/test_logrotate.py::test_logrotate_small_size` intermittently fails during setup on t2 KVM Elastictest after it remounts `/var/log` and calls `config_reload(..., wait_for_bgp=True)`.

This issue has been split from the broader original report. The separate `test_logrotate_normal_size` assertion failure is tracked in: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/25360

**Observed in failed plan:**
- Elastictest plan: https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/6a2e403f729d944bd21ca1ce
- PR under test: sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#26724
- Build: `1138047`
- Topology: `t2`, KVM, `vms-kvm-t2`

**Base run behavior:**
- `test_logrotate_normal_size` passed
- `test_logrotate_small_size` errored in setup
- Failure summary:

```text
failed on setup with "Failed: Not all bgp sessions are established after config reload"
```

**Teardown also failed:**

```text
mv: cannot stat '/var/log/syslog_bk': No such file or directory
```

### Root Cause Analysis

There are two likely problems in this specific failure mode:

1. `simulate_small_var_log_partition` mounts a new filesystem over `/var/log`, then runs:

```python
config_reload(duthost, safe_reload=True, check_intf_up_ports=True, wait_for_bgp=True)
```

On t2 KVM this can fail because BGP does not fully converge after config reload within the wait window. This is unrelated to logrotate behavior itself.

2. `backup_syslog` stores `/var/log/syslog_bk` inside `/var/log`:

```python
duthost.shell('sudo cp -f /var/log/syslog /var/log/syslog_bk')
...
duthost.shell('sudo mv /var/log/syslog_bk /var/log/syslog')
```

But `simulate_small_var_log_partition` later mounts a new filesystem on `/var/log`. If setup fails before the fixture reaches `yield`, its cleanup does not run, and the module-level teardown cannot find `/var/log/syslog_bk` in the currently mounted `/var/log`.

### Why this is flaky / not PR-specific

Kusto history for `syslog.test_logrotate::test_logrotate_small_size` setup failures shows this is widespread across PRs:

- last 30 days: **72 hits / 71 test plans / 67 PRs**
- branches: `master`, `internal`
- topologies: `t1-lag`, `t1-8-lag`, `t2`

The PR under test (`sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#26724`) changes docker-sonic-vs feature composition and does not modify syslog/logrotate or BGP convergence logic.

### Suggested Fix

1. Make `simulate_small_var_log_partition` cleanup robust with `try/finally` so `/var/log` is unmounted and `/dev/loop2` is detached even when `config_reload()` fails before `yield`.
2. Store the syslog backup outside `/var/log`, or recreate it after mounting the small `/var/log` filesystem.
3. Consider whether this logrotate test really needs `wait_for_bgp=True`; if not, avoid making logrotate validation depend on full BGP convergence.
4. If BGP convergence is still required, collect BGP neighbor state on failure so this can be triaged separately from logrotate behavior.

### Steps to reproduce

Run `tests/syslog/test_logrotate.py` on a t2 KVM Elastictest plan. The failure is intermittent.

### Link to failed CI run

- Azure DevOps build: https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/be1b070f-be15-4154-aade-b1d3bfb17054/_build/results?buildId=1138047&view=logs&jobId=3ab7146d-ea64-5d52-0097-33a9aae59fb6
- Elastictest plan: https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/6a2e403f729d944bd21ca1ce
- PR: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/26724

### Related Issues

- https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/25360 — split-out issue for `test_logrotate_normal_size` assertion failure
- #23051
- #13451
- #16055
- #11179

resolution.title: Improve logrotate test isolation and cleanup
resolution.description:
## Description

Improve `tests/syslog/test_logrotate.py` isolation and cleanup for the intermittent Elastictest failures tracked in #25353 and #25360.

Changes:
- Store the module-level syslog backup outside `/var/log`, so it is not hidden/lost when `test_logrotate_small_size` mounts a temporary filesystem on `/var/log`.
- Make the small `/var/log` fixture cleanup run from `finally`, including when setup fails before `yield`.
- Make cleanup best-effort after setup failure so cleanup errors do not hide the original `config_reload`/BGP setup failure.
- Use a test-specific logrotate state file (`/tmp/logrotate-test.status`) so the test is isolated from the DUT's normal `/var/lib/logrotate/status` state.
- Log logrotate return code/stdout/stderr and collect syslog/logrotate state on assertion failures.

## Motivation and Context

In Elastictest plan `6a2e403f729d944bd21ca1ce`, `syslog/test_logrotate.py` failed in two different ways:

1. `test_logrotate_small_size` failed during setup after remounting `/var/log`, then teardown failed with:
   ```text
   mv: cannot stat '/var/log/syslog_bk': No such file or directory
   ```
   because the backup lived under `/var/log` and the fixture cleanup did not run when setup failed before `yield`.

2. Retry runs of `test_logrotate_normal_size` failed with:
   ```text
   AssertionError: No logrotate happens, both syslog file number and timestamp are the same
   ```
   but the test did not capture enough state to explain why logrotate skipped rotation.

## Testing

- `python3 -m py_compile tests/syslog/test_logrotate.py`
- `git diff --check`

Full behavioral validation requires a SONiC KVM/t2 Elastictest run.

Fixes #25353
Fixes #25360
